identity.name: Foreign Policy
identity.description: An American global-affairs publication combining reported analysis, argument and policy journalism on diplomacy, security, economics and international institutions.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Commercial policy publisher owned by FP Group, a division of Graham Holdings. It has a strong Washington policy-network orientation but no direct state ownership.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Publishes multiple perspectives and critical analysis of US policy; no evidence of a single owner-directed editorial line.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC rates the publication Least Biased; article mix spans realist, liberal-internationalist and critical viewpoints.

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic coverage is policy-analytic and plural, without a consistent free-market or state-directed editorial programme.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Coverage is written largely for a US policy audience and often assumes US leadership and alliance management, while publishing critiques of those assumptions.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC rates factual reporting High and credibility High; established editorial operation with named authors and corrections.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: Least Biased; factual reporting High; credibility High (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Washington policy-insider analysis. Explains world events through US strategy, institutions and elite policy debate, with more interpretive depth and more ideological range than a straight wire.

selectionRationale: Adds interpretive depth on US foreign policy and global institutions that complements wire coverage and non-US perspectives.

research.researchNotes: Ownership confirmed via official About page and Graham Holdings references. Existing production mapping retained. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
